title: Wikimedia Foundation research report cover with Humaaans figures
lede: The title slide of a 2019 Wikimedia Foundation design research report: bold black type on the left and two Humaaans figures passing an image card in front of a pale app window on the right.
summary: Two flat Humaaans figures in front of a grey wireframe window, beside bold sans-serif titles. Research slide deck, 2019.

source.label: Wikimedia Commons: Android Microcontributions Phase 1 & 2 Findings Report

creator.name: Daisy Chen, Wikimedia Foundation Product Design Strategy

evidence.note: Inspected the 1280 × 720 rendering of page 1 of the PDF on Wikimedia Commons and stored it. Only the title slide was reviewed.

styles.note: Clear fit in use: stock [Humaaans](ref:humaaans-illustration-library-2018) figures as a spot illustration in white space next to a wireframe interface, the typical layout of tech decks and landing pages.

context: Commons describes the file as user research on what motivates and retains Wikipedia editors who use the section editor in the Android app, by Daisy Chen, under CC BY-SA 4.0. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Android_Microcontributions_Phase1%262_Findings_Report.pdf).
The slide credits its image to humaaans.com.
observed: The left half has a short rule and a heavy black sans-serif title, “Android Microcontributions”, with three bullet lines and the author’s name.
On the right, a pale grey browser window shows grey placeholder lines and circles like a wireframe list.
Two figures stand in front of it: one in a blue top and red trousers holds out a blue image card, the other in a red jacket and navy trousers reaches for it.
The figures have small blank heads, long limbs, and flat fills without outlines; the page is white.
interpretation: It shows the style as off-the-shelf corporate furniture: free figures added to a research deck to make it friendly, with no custom drawing.
borrow: Pair one flat figure scene with a wireframe window behind it to signal “product” without showing a real screen.

images.alt: Title slide: bold black text “Android Microcontributions” on the left; on the right two flat long-limbed figures pass a blue image card in front of a pale grey wireframe browser window.
images.caption: Title slide of “Android Microcontributions Phase 1 & 2 Findings Report” by Daisy Chen, Wikimedia Foundation, 2019. CC BY-SA 4.0. Figures from Humaaans. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Android_Microcontributions_Phase1%262_Findings_Report.pdf).
